name: Amazon 1,800 suspected infiltration attempts

attribution.legal_posture: First-party Amazon employer statement about suspected applicant detections; it is an employer report rather than an identity adjudication, confirmed-hire count, or criminal finding.

caveats: Suspected attempts remain suspected attempts; confirm DPRK identities or hires only with supporting evidence.
Latency is one correlated signal; nationality assessment requires corroboration.
The evidence supports aggregate treatment rather than an individual record.

statements: Amazon CSO Stephen Schmidt stated that Amazon stopped more than 1,800 suspected DPRK operatives from joining between April 2024 and December 18, 2025.

Schmidt reported 27 percent quarter-over-quarter growth in applications Amazon labeled DPRK-affiliated and described AI screening paired with human verification, background and credential checks, structured interviews, application anomalies, geographic inconsistencies, and links to nearly 200 high-risk institutions.
Amazon's labels are internal risk assessments: more than 1,800 suspected attempts are not 1,800 confirmed DPRK identities, employees, successful hires, or criminal findings.
